note: Free-form collection script v1 for isiNdebele (2026-10-27), derived from freeform-v1, the Shona free-form script. The cue cards, topics and numbers are the same English prompts, in the same order. Ids carry the nd_ prefix, so they never collide with Shona ids. Every instruction that said Shona says Ndebele. Four categories, as in freeform-v1. free_form_cue (40): an English scenario plus key words; she speaks freely in Ndebele, mixing English as she naturally would, 30 to 90 s per take. own_words (20): an English topic; she replaces the prompt text with her own Ndebele through Edit prompt before the take, so the clip transcript is exactly what she read. free_form_numbers (10): amounts written the way a trader writes them; she says them in street register. session_start (5): 5 s of room tone, then one fixed price sentence, described here in English and said in Ndebele in the same words every session, for level, rate and pitch drift checks; calibration only, keep it out of training. This file holds no Ndebele text. For free_form_cue, free_form_numbers and session_start the stored transcript is the English prompt text and needs a verbatim Ndebele transcript (ASR draft plus native correction). own_words transcripts are her typed text.
